analytics_requirements.requirement: POST /orders accepts customerId and one or more lines, each containing sku and a positive quantity.
Reject a line with an unknown SKU or a quantity that is zero or negative.
For a successful request, create an order in CREATED status, calculate the line-total sum, and emit order.created with the new order identifier.

source_context_and_provenance.context: create validates the customer and validates that all lines have known SKUs and positive quantities before saving Order.created(customerId, lines).
After saving, create publishes new OrderCreated(order.id()) and returns the order.
